_doc: Roaming gods: ignored until the player is within `near` tiles, then they turn and say a rude one-liner (rotating). Talking 3+ times within 60 s triggers the god's `pester` effect (harmless). home: {lat, lon, dx, dy (world px)} ; radius in tiles; speed in px/s; glow = rgb of the additive aura; fx = sparkle | drip | ember | streak. A line may be {t, steal:true} (Hermes takes 1 owl and flicks it back 2 s later). Marble story statues live in data/characters.json and are separate.

gods.name: Athena
lines: Owls are wiser than you. No offence. Some offence.
I won this city fair and square. Poseidon still sulks.
You're standing on my olive's roots.

gods.name: Poseidon
lines: They chose a TREE. Over the sea. A tree!
Mind the puddles. They're mine.
Salt water is a perfectly good gift.

gods.name: Zeus
lines: Six hundred and fifty years to finish my temple. Mortals are so slow.
Kneel. Or don't. I'll remember either way.
Don't look directly at me. Thunderbolt allergy.

gods.name: Hera
lines: Have you seen my husband? He's always busy.
My peacock is prettier than you.

gods.name: Hephaestus
lines: Out of my forge. Busy.
My mother threw me off a mountain. Go on, ask about my day.
Touch that anvil and I'll make you a chain.

gods.name: Hermes
lines: Message for you: you're slow.
Who smashed my statues? I know. I'm not telling.

gods.name: Dionysus
lines: Applause, please. No? Rude.
Pirates. Dolphins. Long story.
Tragedy or comedy? Depends on your face.

gods.name: Ares
lines: Fight me. No? Coward.
They put ME on trial. Here. The cheek.

gods.name: Aphrodite
lines: Mirror? You need one.
Love is complicated. Ask Paris. Actually, don't.

gods.name: Demeter
lines: Have you seen my daughter? Again?
Eat your vegetables. I grew them.

gods.name: Nike
lines: I would fly away, but they took my wings.
Winning isn't everything. It's nearly everything.
